name: @paths.design/caws-cli
description: CAWS CLI: project governance with a shared machine runtime and native agent harness adapters.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-surface-registry.mjs && node scripts/check-surface-registry.mjs && node scripts/build-cli.js
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/stage-consumer-docs.mjs && node scripts/generate-command-reference.mjs --check && node scripts/populate-doc-markers.mjs --check
scripts.build:docs: node scripts/build-cli.js && node scripts/generate-command-reference.mjs && node scripts/populate-doc-markers.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && jest --testPathIgnorePatterns='perf-budgets|integration|e2e|mutation|axe|contract' && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:contract: npm run build && jest --testPathPatterns=contract && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && jest --testPathPatterns=integration && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && jest --testPathPatterns=e2e && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.mutation:run:kernel: npm run build && node scripts/run-mutation.mjs --surface kernel
scripts.mutation:run:store: npm run build && node scripts/run-mutation.mjs --surface store
scripts.mutation:run:shell: npm run build && node scripts/run-mutation.mjs --surface shell
scripts.test:axe: npm run build && jest --testPathPatterns=axe && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.qualify:native:containment: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path ../caws-native/Cargo.toml && tsc --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools scripts/qualify-native-containment.ts && node ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools/qualify-native-containment.js .
scripts.qualify:native:services: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path ../caws-native/Cargo.toml --bin caws-native --example service-observer && tsc --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools scripts/qualify-native-services.ts && node ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools/qualify-native-services.js .
scripts.qualify:native:render-build: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path ../caws-native/Cargo.toml --bin caws-native --example service-observer --example service-custody-observer && tsc --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools scripts/qualify-render-owner.ts scripts/qualify-render-lifecycle.ts scripts/qualify-render-legacy.ts scripts/qualify-render-load.ts scripts/qualify-plan-snapshots.ts scripts/qualify-render-pending.ts scripts/qualify-render-plan-snapshots.ts
scripts.qualify:native:substitution: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path ../caws-native/Cargo.toml --bin caws-native && tsc --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools scripts/qualify-native-substitution.ts && node ../caws-native/target/qualification-tools/qualify-native-substitution.js
scripts.test:pytest: python3 -m venv tests/hooks/pytest/.venv && tests/hooks/pytest/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r tests/hooks/pytest/requirements.txt && tests/hooks/pytest/.venv/bin/pytest tests/hooks/pytest
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist test-caws-project .agent && npm run test:cleanup

author: Paths Design <hello@paths.design>
